description: This file defines a request handler class 'GetOrderDetailsHandler' that handles requests to retrieve detailed information about a specific order, including order items and shipping address. It interacts with the order repository, uses specifications to query data, and returns a view model containing order details.

classes.name: GetOrderDetailsHandler
classes.description: A request handler class implementing IRequestHandler to process GetOrderDetails requests and produce OrderDetailViewModel responses.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the GetOrderDetails request, retrieves the order with items from the repository using a specification, and maps it to an OrderDetailViewModel.
